text.p: Strayer Education Inc said on Monday its board of directors approved an initial $0.0625 per share dividend for the quarter ended September 30, payable on October 16 to shareholders of record on October 2.
The regional proprietary institute of higher learning also said enrollment for Strayer College's fall term increased 10 percent to over 8,100 students, compared to last year's enrollment.
Strayer, which had a 3.45 million share initial public offering in July, offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to students on eight campuses in Washington D.C. and northern Virginia.
